sources.supports: xAI's official pricing table expresses cached prompt tokens as a cached input category; it has no separate cache-write price category. This supports treating models.dev's added cache_write field as its own error, though this current page does not document the historical Grok 3 rates.

sources.quote: You can now use cached prompt to save on repeated prompts.
sources.supports: xAI described the caching feature as cached prompts, rather than a separately priced cache-write operation.

notes: Classified as models_dev_fix because the provider's own pricing materials identify cached input/prompt pricing and do not identify a cache-write rate; the recorded difference is the removal of that extra field. The official historical Grok 3 Fast price and its effective date are not stated by the accessible sources, so those values are null. Internet Archive was unavailable from this environment, preventing a historical snapshot comparison.
